questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
Consider the following standard electrode potentials (Eo in volts) in aqueous solution :

Element M3+ /M M+ /M
A1 -1.66 + 0.55
T1 +1.26 - 0.34


Based on these data, which of the following statements is correct ?

options.content: T1<sup>+</sup> is more stable than A1<sup>3+</sup>
A1<sup>+</sup> is more stable than A1<sup>3+</sup>
T1 <sup>+</sup> is more stable than A1<sup>+</sup>
T1<sup>3+</sup> is more stable than A1<sup>3+</sup>

questions.explanation:
The standard electrode potential E0 for M+/M become negative for Tl which indicates that Tl+ is more stable than Al+.

This can also be be explained by inert pair effect. The atoms of this group have an outer electronic configuration of s2p1. The two s electrons of Tl do not participate in bonding due to poor shielding of d electrons.
